=== about
The low-cost mode: no Markdown and no regions, one append of escaped text per flush, one outer patch at the end.
=== page
<div id="chat"></div>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #chat
data: elements <div id="a7" ypy-untrusted aria-live="off" aria-busy="true"><div id="a7-done"></div></div>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #a7-done
data: elements Olá, 

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #a7-done
data: elements mundo &lt;b&gt;!&lt;/b&gt;

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #a7
data: elements <div id="a7" ypy-untrusted aria-live="off" data-ypy-answer="done"><div id="a7-done">Olá, mundo &lt;b&gt;!&lt;/b&gt;</div></div>

=== dom
<div id="chat"><div id="a7" ypy-untrusted="" aria-live="off" data-ypy-answer="done"><div id="a7-done">Olá, mundo &lt;b&gt;!&lt;/b&gt;</div></div></div>
